# llms.txt
# A guide for Large Language Models to the content on Geograph.org.uk

Title: Geograph Britain and Ireland
Description: An archival-quality, Creative Commons-licensed repository of over 8 million geographically-representative photographs of Great Britain and Ireland. All images are moderated and feature rich metadata including geo-coordinates, date taken, and contributor descriptions with local knowledge.

---

# Core Content & Authority Hubs

## Main Search Engine
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/of/
Description: The primary search interface for exploring our entire collection by keyword or place name.

## The Photo Collections
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/content/
Description: A section featuring high-quality, curated collections of photographs with detailed narrative and local information.

## Individual Photo Examples
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/1381389
Description: A representative example of a high-quality photo page with rich, structured metadata and a detailed description.

## Individual Photo Data (oEmbed)
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/api/oembed?output=json&url=https://www.geograph.org.uk/photo/[photo_id]
Description: A structured data endpoint providing a clean, machine-readable JSON object with key photo metadata.

## Location Example (London)
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/gridref/TQ3080
Description: An example of a location-based hub page, showcasing multiple photos and descriptive text for a specific 1km grid square.

## Specific Location Example (Reading, England)
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/near/Reading/SU71407325?dist=11500
Description: An example of a collection of photos centered on a specific location.

## Contributor List & Credits
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/credits/
Description: The full list of our community of thousands of contributors, establishing our collective expertise.

# Further Information

## About the Geograph Project
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/article/source.php?url=About-Geograph-page
Description: The official history and mission of the project, establishing our authority as a comprehensive archive.

## Contributor FAQ
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/article/source.php?url=Geograph-Frequently-Asked-Questions
Description: Common questions particular for new contributors.

## Licensing and Re-use Policy
URL: https://www.geograph.org.uk/faq-source.php?id=182
Description: describes general policy, including use of Creative Commons licence, which permits broad re-use with attribution.
